Living wall partners & suppliers

Working with leading UK plant wholesalers to bring living walls to more projects.

Life on Walls partners with established horticultural businesses so that landscape professionals, garden designers, contractors and retailers can discover modular living wall systems, including Living Louvres, alongside the plants they already source.

01 — Our partners

Two partners, one aim: more greening in more places.

Our partners combine horticultural expertise and trade networks with our living wall technology.

01 · Wholesale plant nursery

Evergreen Exterior Services

Banstead, Surrey

An established wholesale plant nursery, founded in 1986, supplying trees, shrubs, climbers, grasses, perennials and specimen plants to trade customers across the UK. Evergreen is introducing selected Life on Walls products, including Living Louvres, to its offering.

Learn more →

02 · Plant wholesaler

Ilo Bloom

New Covent Garden Flower Market, London

A specialist plant wholesaler at New Covent Garden Flower Market, known for its approachable team, fresh plant selections and industry knowledge. Together we help professionals bring planting into indoor and outdoor spaces.

Learn more →

02 — Why we partner

Making vertical greening more accessible.

Living walls work best when the right plants, the right system and the right advice come together. Our partners are trusted sources of plants for the people who design and build gardens, terraces and commercial spaces.

By working with them, Life on Walls can introduce its modular living wall systems, such as Living Louvres, to more landscape professionals, while our partners offer their customers practical, innovative ways to add greenery to vertical surfaces.

03 — Questions

Frequently asked questions

Who are Life on Walls’ partners?

Life on Walls currently partners with two UK plant wholesalers: Evergreen Exterior Services, a wholesale plant nursery in Banstead, Surrey, and Ilo Bloom, a specialist plant wholesaler at New Covent Garden Flower Market in London.

Why does Life on Walls partner with plant wholesalers?

Plant wholesalers already supply the landscape professionals, garden designers, contractors and retailers who specify greening. Partnering with them brings Life on Walls’ modular living wall systems, such as Living Louvres, to those customers alongside the plants they already buy, making vertical greening more accessible.

Where can I see Life on Walls products through a partner?

Evergreen Exterior Services is introducing selected Life on Walls products, including Living Louvres, to its trade offering at its nursery in Banstead, Surrey. Ilo Bloom works with Life on Walls from New Covent Garden Flower Market in London.

Can my business become a Life on Walls partner?

Yes. Life on Walls welcomes conversations with nurseries, plant wholesalers, landscapers and other horticultural businesses. Get in touch with the team to discuss a partnership.

Next step

Interested in partnering with Life on Walls?

We work with nurseries, wholesalers and horticultural businesses that share our passion for long-lasting, well-engineered greening. Tell us about your business and we will be in touch.
